title: SpatialDAO
tagline: The Spatial DAO is a blockchain ecosystem built for storing geospatial and weather data on blockchain
description: The Spatial DAO is a blockchain ecosystem built for storing geospatial and weather data on blockchain. It is based on Ethereum(EVM) and filecoin platforms, which means that it can be leveraged by other projects too. In addition to being open to the public, the platform can also be used by businesses.
how_its_made:
It is based on Ethereum(EVM) and filecoin platforms. Solidity smart contracts. DataDAO framework to support large data assets.
Spatial data is complex , the DAO focus on providing standardised spatial data for various AI/ML applications and use cases. The DAO shall manage the governance of on boarding, standardising and distribution of spatial data sets.
